summary: Itau Unibanco filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2Q26 earnings press release. The report details a quarterly recurring managerial result of BRL 12.4 billion, ROE of 24.3%, a total credit portfolio of BRL 1.5 trillion, and a stable 1.9% NPL ratio. This is a routine periodic financial results announcement, not a special-situations event. No transactions, strategic reviews, or corporate actions are described. The filing is an ordinary disclosure of operating performance under Rule 13a-16, with no special-situation category applicable. No deal terms, premiums, or structural elements are present. The only watch item is continued credit growth and profitability metrics.
